title: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 is vulnerable to improper credential handling because the…
description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway versions 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 have a vulnerability in improper credential handling. The X-Upstream-Authorization request header can override the gateway-managed upstream credentials for OAuth, bearer, and basic authenticated gateways. This flaw allows an authenticated user to make upstream requests with different credentials, bypassing per-user permission checks and audit attribution.
